S_STP.answer: I would call the game Corner Pass. The aim is to carry a soft ball from one end of a court to the other by passing it. Two small teams could play on the school court. W_STP.answer:
From my point of view, the school should choose the obstacle race because it would reward different skills. Fast running is only one way to do well in that race. For example, a pupil who is good at balancing might get across the low steps without slowing down. That pupil would have a chance to do well even if someone else could run faster.

From my point of view, the school should keep the running race because obstacles would take extra time to set up. Teachers would have to put each one in place and check that it was safe. For example, they might need to fix a loose step just before the race. That delay could leave less time for the other events.
